+import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
+
+type Comment = { id: string; author: string; html: string };
+
+export function CommentList({ comments }: { comments: Comment[] }) {
+  return (
+    <ul>
+      {comments.map((c) => (
+        <li key={c.id}>
+          <strong>{c.author}</strong>
+          <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: c.html }} />
+        </li>
+      ))}
+    </ul>
+  );
+}
+
+export function LiveCount({ endpoint }: { endpoint: string }) {
+  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setInterval(async () => {
+      const res = await fetch(endpoint);
+      const body: { count: number } = await res.json();
+      setCount(body.count);
+    }, 5000);
+  }, []);
+  return <span>{count}</span>;
+}
+
+export function ReplyToggle({ open, onToggle }: { open: boolean; onToggle: () => void }) {
+  return (
+    <div className="reply-toggle" onClick={onToggle}>
+      {open ? "Hide reply" : "Reply"}
+    </div>
+  );
+}
+
+const NAV = ["Home", "Orders", "Settings"] as const;
+
+export function NavBar() {
+  return (
+    <nav>
+      <ul>
+        {NAV.map((label, i) => (
+          <li key={i}>{label}</li>
+        ))}
+      </ul>
+    </nav>
+  );
+}
+
+export function SearchBox({ onSearch }: { onSearch: (query: string) => void }) {
+  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
+  return (
+    <form
+      onSubmit={(e) => {
+        e.preventDefault();
+        onSearch(query.trim());
+      }}
+    >
+      <label htmlFor="q">Search</label>
+      <input id="q" name="q" value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} />
+      <button type="submit">Go</button>
+    </form>
+  );
+}
